definitions.pair: Baseline/candidate from the same alternating trial, not arbitrary sorted observations
definitions.wall: Existing product phase wall excludes diagnostic probe/GC; CPU is process total including diagnostics
definitions.off_cpu_limit: Wall minus process CPU is not measured wait; multi-thread CPU can exceed elapsed time
definitions.gc_pause: STW pause counters exclude concurrent/assist GC CPU; cycle counts do not measure time
definitions.profiling: Full-process samples include workload, Go observer/GC and profile finalization; on/off cohorts stay separate

observer-0-candidate-cpu.limits: Groups overlap and must not be summed. CPU sample positions, not wall-wait durations. Systemstack allocation samples do not identify the triggering application allocation.
